release.title: Release Staff

course.liveStartText: Starting a course creates a real staff course entry. Stat gains apply when the backend completion processor finishes the course. Courses cannot be canceled once booked. Staff bonuses from this role are paused until the course is completed.
course.none: No course options are configured for this staff role yet. This prevents the wrong course type from being started until backend course codes are added for this role.
